title: Emergency USB Stick | United States
headline: What do you need now?
lead: Choose a situation or search for a word. Every guide is also saved as an ordinary text file on this drive.

emergency.title: Immediate danger?
emergency.text: In the United States, call 911 for police, fire, or ambulance emergencies. Tell the call-taker where you are and follow their instructions.

offline_note: This drive cannot show live alerts. Check official local information when you can. Follow current instructions from responders.

links.label: Other ways to use this drive

personal.title: Your files
personal.lead: Put your own photos, maps, and documents in these folders. You can also open them directly in a file manager.
personal.private: Sensitive files: read the encryption guide first
personal.empty: No personal files linked yet. Open the folders directly.
personal.rebuild: The folders work without extra software. An optional program to refresh these links is in the Infrastructure folder.

sources.title: Sources and review dates
sources.lead: These guides draw on the listed sources. Alerts and local rules can change.
